schema.text: What stops you from cycling or riding an e-scooter more often? (Select all that apply)
schema.help: We ask this to understand what limits cycling and e-scooter use for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.

options.text: No cycle lanes or no continuous routes to where I go
Nowhere secure to keep it at home or to park it at my destination
I don't have a bicycle or e-scooter, and there is no sharing service near me
I can't ride, or I don't feel able to
My health, a disability or my age makes it difficult
I carry heavy things or accompany children or other people
I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better

it.#What stops you from cycling or riding a: Che cosa ti impedisce di usare più spesso la bicicletta o il monopattino? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#We ask this to understand what limits c: Lo chiediamo per capire che cosa limita l'uso della bici e del monopattino per persone diverse. Rispondere è facoltativo e puoi anche scegliere di non dirlo.
it.#Traffic feels too dangerous: Il traffico mi sembra troppo pericoloso
it.#No cycle lanes or no continuous routes: Mancano piste ciclabili o percorsi continui fino a dove devo andare
it.#Nowhere secure to keep it at home or to: Non ho un posto sicuro dove tenere il mezzo a casa o lasciarlo a destinazione
it.#I don't have a bicycle or e-scooter, an: Non ho una bicicletta o un monopattino e non c'è un servizio di sharing vicino a me
it.#I can't ride, or I don't feel able to: Non so andarci o non me la sento
it.#My health, a disability or my age makes: La mia salute, una disabilità o l'età me lo rendono difficile
it.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Porto oggetti pesanti o accompagno bambini o altre persone
it.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Non mi serve: altri modi di spostarmi sono più adatti a me

fr.#What stops you from cycling or riding a: Qu'est-ce qui vous empêche d'utiliser plus souvent le vélo ou la trottinette électrique ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#We ask this to understand what limits c: Nous posons cette question pour comprendre ce qui limite l'usage du vélo et de la trottinette électrique selon les personnes. Répondre est facultatif, et vous pouvez aussi choisir de ne pas le dire.
fr.#Hills and steep slopes: Les côtes et les pentes raides
fr.#Traffic feels too dangerous: La circulation me semble trop dangereuse
fr.#No cycle lanes or no continuous routes: Pas de pistes cyclables ou pas d'itinéraires continus jusqu'à mes destinations
fr.#Nowhere secure to keep it at home or to: Aucun endroit sûr pour le ranger chez moi ou le garer à destination
fr.#I don't have a bicycle or e-scooter, an: Je n'ai ni vélo ni trottinette, et il n'y a pas de service en libre-service près de chez moi
fr.#I can't ride, or I don't feel able to: Je ne sais pas en faire ou je ne m'en sens pas capable
fr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Ma santé, un handicap ou mon âge rendent cela difficile
fr.#Heat or bad weather: La chaleur ou le mauvais temps
fr.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Je porte des choses lourdes ou j'accompagne des enfants ou d'autres personnes
fr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Je n'en ai pas besoin : d'autres moyens de déplacement me conviennent mieux

de.#What stops you from cycling or riding a: Was hält Sie davon ab, häufiger Fahrrad oder E-Scooter zu fahren? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#We ask this to understand what limits c: Wir fragen dies, um zu verstehen, was die Nutzung von Fahrrad und E-Scooter für verschiedene Menschen einschränkt. Die Antwort ist freiwillig, und Sie können auch angeben, dass Sie es lieber nicht sagen möchten.
de.#Traffic feels too dangerous: Der Verkehr erscheint mir zu gefährlich
de.#No cycle lanes or no continuous routes: Keine Radwege oder keine durchgehenden Routen zu meinen Zielen
de.#Nowhere secure to keep it at home or to: Kein sicherer Abstellplatz zu Hause oder am Ziel
de.#I don't have a bicycle or e-scooter, an: Ich habe weder Fahrrad noch E-Scooter, und in meiner Nähe gibt es keinen Sharing-Dienst
de.#I can't ride, or I don't feel able to: Ich kann nicht fahren oder traue es mir nicht zu
de.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Meine Gesundheit, eine Behinderung oder mein Alter machen es mir schwer
de.#Destinations are too far away: Die Ziele sind zu weit entfernt
de.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Ich trage schwere Dinge oder begleite Kinder oder andere Personen
de.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Ich brauche es nicht: Andere Fortbewegungsarten passen besser zu mir

tr.#What stops you from cycling or riding a: Daha sık bisiklete veya elektrikli scootera binmenizi engelleyen nedir? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#We ask this to understand what limits c: Bunu, farklı kişiler için bisiklet ve e-scooter kullanımını neyin sınırladığını anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır; belirtmemeyi de seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#No cycle lanes or no continuous routes: Gittiğim yerlere bisiklet yolu ya da kesintisiz güzergâh yok
tr.#Nowhere secure to keep it at home or to: Evde saklayacak ya da gittiğim yerde park edecek güvenli bir yer yok
tr.#I don't have a bicycle or e-scooter, an: Bisikletim veya elektrikli scooterım yok ve yakınımda paylaşım hizmeti bulunmuyor
tr.#I can't ride, or I don't feel able to: Binmeyi bilmiyorum ya da kendimi yeterli hissetmiyorum
tr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Sağlığım, bir engelim veya yaşım bunu zorlaştırıyor
tr.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Ağır eşyalar taşıyorum veya çocuklara ya da başka kişilere eşlik ediyorum
tr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Gerek duymuyorum: başka ulaşım yolları bana daha uygun

fa.#What stops you from cycling or riding a: چه چیزی مانع می‌شود که بیشتر از دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی استفاده کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#We ask this to understand what limits c: این را می‌پرسیم تا بفهمیم چه چیزی استفاده از دوچرخه و اسکوتر برقی را برای افراد مختلف محدود می‌کند. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و می‌توانید ترجیح دهید آن را نگویید.
fa.#Traffic feels too dangerous: ترافیک به نظرم خیلی خطرناک است
fa.#No cycle lanes or no continuous routes: مسیر دوچرخه یا مسیر پیوسته تا مقصدهایم وجود ندارد
fa.#Nowhere secure to keep it at home or to: جای امنی برای نگهداری آن در خانه یا پارک آن در مقصد ندارم
fa.#I don't have a bicycle or e-scooter, an: دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی ندارم و نزدیک من سرویس اشتراکی وجود ندارد
fa.#I can't ride, or I don't feel able to: بلد نیستم سوار شوم یا احساس توانایی نمی‌کنم
fa.#My health, a disability or my age makes: وضعیت سلامتی، معلولیت یا سنم این کار را دشوار می‌کند
fa.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: وسایل سنگین حمل می‌کنم یا کودکان یا افراد دیگر را همراهی می‌کنم
fa.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: نیازی ندارم: روش‌های دیگر جابه‌جایی برایم مناسب‌ترند

hu.#What stops you from cycling or riding a: Mi akadályozza abban, hogy gyakrabban kerékpározzon vagy használjon elektromos rollert? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#We ask this to understand what limits c: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megértsük, mi korlátozza a kerékpár és az elektromos roller használatát a különböző emberek számára. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és azt is választhatja, hogy nem kívánja megadni.
hu.#No cycle lanes or no continuous routes: Nincs kerékpárút, vagy nincs összefüggő útvonal oda, ahová megyek
hu.#Nowhere secure to keep it at home or to: Nincs biztonságos hely a tárolására otthon vagy a leparkolására a célnál
hu.#I don't have a bicycle or e-scooter, an: Nincs kerékpárom vagy elektromos rollerem, és a közelemben nincs megosztási szolgáltatás
hu.#I can't ride, or I don't feel able to: Nem tudok rajta közlekedni, vagy nem érzem magam rá képesnek
hu.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Az egészségi állapotom, egy fogyatékosság vagy a korom megnehezíti
hu.#Destinations are too far away: Az úti célok túl messze vannak
hu.#Heat or bad weather: A hőség vagy a rossz idő
hu.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: Nehéz dolgokat viszek, vagy gyerekeket, illetve másokat kísérek
hu.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Nincs rá szükségem: más közlekedési módok jobban megfelelnek nekem

ar.#What stops you from cycling or riding a: ما الذي يمنعك من استخدام الدراجة الهوائية أو السكوتر الكهربائي أكثر؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#We ask this to understand what limits c: نسأل عن ذلك لنفهم ما الذي يحدّ من استخدام الدراجة والسكوتر الكهربائي لدى أشخاص مختلفين. الإجابة اختيارية، ويمكنك أيضًا اختيار عدم الإفصاح.
ar.#No cycle lanes or no continuous routes: لا توجد مسارات للدراجات أو طرق متصلة إلى الأماكن التي أذهب إليها
ar.#Nowhere secure to keep it at home or to: لا يوجد مكان آمن لحفظها في المنزل أو ركنها عند وجهتي
ar.#I don't have a bicycle or e-scooter, an: لا أملك دراجة هوائية أو سكوترًا كهربائيًا، ولا توجد خدمة مشاركة بالقرب مني
ar.#I can't ride, or I don't feel able to: لا أعرف القيادة أو لا أشعر بأنني قادر على ذلك
ar.#My health, a disability or my age makes: صحتي أو إعاقة أو عمري يجعل ذلك صعبًا
ar.#I carry heavy things or accompany child: أحمل أشياء ثقيلة أو أرافق أطفالًا أو أشخاصًا آخرين
ar.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: لا أحتاج إلى ذلك: وسائل تنقّل أخرى تناسبني أكثر
